inlines.v: ACCURS'ED, participle passive or adjective 1. Doomed to destruction or misery: The city shall be accursed. Joshua 6:17 2. Separated from the faithful; cast out of the church; excommunicated. I could wish myself accursed from Christ. 3. Worthy of the curse; detestable; execrable. Keep from the accursed thing. Joshua 6:18. Hence, 4. Wicked; malignant in the extreme.
